capabilities: Open embedded images in a fullscreen overlay on double-click or double-tap
Zoom images up to 10x with pinch gestures on touch or trackpad
Pan zoomed images with two-finger swipe or mouse drag
Close the overlay with double-click or the Esc key
Reset zoom to normal with the 0 key
disambiguation: Not an image editor or file manager; it only adds a fullscreen viewing overlay for images already embedded in notes.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. It has no settings or toolbar by design.
intentEvidence: Obsidian's built-in image preview opens in a side pane and doesn't offer a clean fullscreen flow
motivation: The author wanted a minimal fullscreen image view with gesture-based zoom and pan, since the built-in preview opens in a side pane instead.
problem: Obsidian's built-in image preview opens in a side pane and offers no clean fullscreen flow with pinch zoom and pan.
summary: Fullscreen image viewer that opens embedded images with a double-click and supports pinch-to-zoom and pan gestures.
